decision: Promote the model-bound 131072-row CJK-aware selected Q6 NextN proposal head for Qwen3.8-27B production. Both counterbalanced pairs improve every C5-C8 width and all 80 prompt cells while preserving target IDs, acceptance telemetry, physical ownership, and drain.

selected_head.selection: all Han/Hiragana/Katakana tokenizer rows, all specials, then independent-corpus frequency and deterministic token ID

denominators.draft_acceptance: accepted draft tokens / proposed draft tokens
denominators.position_acceptance: cycles accepting through this position / cycles proposing this position
denominators.conditional_position_acceptance: cycles accepting through this position / cycles accepting the preceding positions while proposing this position

command: set -euo pipefail; COMMON=(--model /models/gguf/Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_M.gguf --backend hip_gfx1100 --quant gguf_q4_k_m --execution-profile production --prompts benchmarks/prompts/mtpbench-code-general-ja.jsonl --mtp-request-mode explicit --widths 5,6,7,8 --resident-capacity 8 --candidate-budget 3 --batch-window-ms 20 --generation2-diagnostic --capture-prefill-attribution --correctness-contract ar_exact --expected-mtp-widths 5,6,7,8 --max-tokens 24); run(){ mode=$1; out=$2; if [ "$mode" = selected ]; then env HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_GGUF_MTP_HOT_VOCAB=/tmp/he-hot-vocab/qwen38-hot131072-cjk-v1.json PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 timeout 1800 .venv/bin/python -u scripts/gguf_mtp_c1c8_server_bench.py "${COMMON[@]}" --output "/tmp/he-hot-vocab/final128/$out"; else env -u HIPENGINE_GGUF_MTP_HOT_VOCAB HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 timeout 1800 .venv/bin/python -u scripts/gguf_mtp_c1c8_server_bench.py "${COMMON[@]}" --output "/tmp/he-hot-vocab/final128/$out"; fi; }; run full r1-full.json; run selected r1-hot.json; run selected r2-hot.json; run full r2-full.json
limitations: The selected head changes only MTP proposal economics; the full target remains authoritative.
The packaged map is exact-model/tokenizer bound and production-only by default. Strict and HIPENGINE_GGUF_MTP_HOT_VOCAB=0 use the full head.
Absolute rates are W7900/epyc same-host evidence and do not transfer to peer machines.
